## Constraints

### Must

- Reuse `--workspace-*` tokens and existing primitives.
- Preserve keyboard focus, responsive states and reduced motion.
- Treat artifact content and metadata as untrusted data.
- Keep media and 3D content bounded on a neutral surface.

### Avoid

- Glassmorphism, decorative gradients, neon and gratuitous animation.
- Fake controls or success states for unavailable capabilities.
- Rendering HTML, SVG or other active artifact content inline.
